citations.claim: body 1 exactly at waypoint (7.13516, 9.59857) before NaN
body 1 position becomes non-finite (null) at first violating step

counterfactual.change: Moved waypoint[1].y from 9.598579837937455 to 10.098579837937455 (0.5m offset) to avoid exact zero distance normalization in controller

explanation: Controller body 1 reaches its waypoint exactly at step 1227 (position equals waypoint). The controller's direction normalization then divides by zero distance, producing NaN position/velocity at next step 1228. Bodies 0,2,3 remain finite but body 1 becomes null. Counterfactual shifting the waypoint by 0.5m avoids exact zero distance and eliminates NaN.
vision_note: Steps 1225-1227 show a red ball hovering near the top and three blue balls near the floor with a waypoint at the top-right. At step 1228 the red violating body completely disappears from the render and the blue bodies suddenly interpenetrate, while a green waypoint cross appears at the red ball's former position.
